name: LM79L05ACZ_NOPB
title: LM79LXXAC: 100 mA fixed negative regulators, -5, -12 and -15 V, in TO-92, SOIC-8 and DSBGA-6
summary: Three-terminal linear regulators that make a fixed -5, -12 or -15 V rail and are specified at 100 mA. The preset output error stays within ±5 % across load, line and temperature, a 0.1 µF output capacitor is enough to compensate them, and they carry their own short-circuit limit, safe-area limit and thermal shutdown. LM79L05ACZ/NOPB is the -5 V part in a TO-92 with straight leads, in bulk.

circuits.title: Fixed output regulator
circuits.description: The basic connection: the negative supply goes into -VIN, the regulated rail comes out of -VOUT, and GND is the common return. C1 and C2 are polarised, each with its positive terminal on ground.

circuits.title: Adjustable output regulator
circuits.description: The -5 V part with its GND pin lifted off ground: R1 runs from -VOUT to the GND pin, and R2, a variable resistor with its wiper joined to its ground end, runs from the GND pin to ground. C3 goes from the GND pin to ground. The output is more negative than -5 V by the drop across R2, per the equation.

circuits.title: ±15V, 100mA dual power supply
circuits.description: A split supply from ±20 V inputs: an LM78L15AC makes +15 V and an LM79L15AC makes -15 V, each good for 100 mA, with both regulators' GND pins on one common ground. Each input and each output has its own capacitor to ground, and the common ground is brought out as the middle output terminal.

operation.text: A three-terminal linear regulator for a fixed negative rail of -5, -12 or -15 V, specified at 100 mA and able to deliver more. Output error is within ±5 % across load, line and temperature; line regulation is at most 0.07 % of VO per volt and load regulation at most 0.01 % of VO per mA.

An output capacitor of at least 0.1 µF is needed for stability and gives good transient response; 1 µF aluminum electrolytic also serves. A 0.33 µF input capacitor is needed when the part is far from the supply's filter capacitor, and again 1 µF aluminum electrolytic may take its place.

Three internal protections: a safe-operating-area circuit limits the output transistor's dissipation, a short-circuit limit that does not move with temperature caps the peak output current, and thermal shutdown stops the junction overheating. Power dissipation is internally limited.

Simple external parts can raise the output voltage or current, or make it adjustable; resistors on the GND pin set a higher output voltage. For other fixed voltages from -1.2 V to -47 V the LM137L adjustable series applies.

Offered in the 3-lead TO-92 (TO-226), the 8-lead SOIC and the 6-bump DSBGA. In the SOIC, pins 2, 3, 6 and 7 are all -VIN and pins 4 and 8 are open; in the DSBGA each terminal has two bumps. AN-1112 (SNVA009) covers DSBGA handling.
The MOS gates inside have only limited ESD protection. Static is kept off them by storing and handling the part with its leads shorted together or pressed into conductive foam.
The TO-92 comes with straight leads in bulk packs only and with formed leads on tape and reel or in ammo packs. The package follows JEDEC TO-226, variation AA.
